title: Puharich's wife's suicide

tellings.quote: I received a grim call from Jenny's father.

plain: In the late 1950s, the scientist Andrija Puharich learned that his wife Jenny had taken her own life, and the news came in what he calls "a grim call from Jenny's father." The episode presents Puharich as a researcher with CIA ties, and the words are his own, a first-hand account of a painful turn in the life of a man later known for claiming contact with otherworldly beings.
